set.body:
Supporting track: Pitch.

Acceptance
1. A one-page brief: the institute's needs, what the MVP does today (taken from the rehearsal notes), and what it does not do.
2. A five-year cost table against the external quote, from docs/product-direction.md section 6, with the quote's terms confirmed or marked unconfirmed.
3. A pilot proposal: scope; a three-month plan; what is asked of the institute (a machine, single sign-on, a research-IT partner, a privacy review); and the conditions under which an external platform would be the better choice.
4. The FAIR table from OPEN5 and the security overview from RUN3, with a plain statement of anything that was rehearsed only on public data or in a sandbox.
5. Statements of interest from two or three investigators (PITCH0).
set.title: PITCH2: Brief, costs, pilot proposal and investigator statements (was D16)
